description: Header file defining the PerThreadSem class, a low-level synchronization primitive used internally by Abseil's threading mechanisms, including functions for thread blocking detection and thread identity management.

classes.name: PerThreadSem
classes.description: A low-level synchronization primitive controlling thread runnability, used internally by Abseil threading components.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Routine invoked periodically by a background thread, with no effect on user-visible state.

methods.name: SetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter pointer used by threadpools to detect blocked threads.

methods.name: GetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Returns the current thread blocked counter pointer.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the PerThreadSem associated with a ThreadIdentity, setting count to zero.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Increments the count for a given ThreadIdentity.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits until the count is greater than zero or a timeout occurs; decrements count if successful.
